description: Valencia open data portal is an open data portal listed in Valencia open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Valencia. The portal lists 269 datasets published by Valencia for Valencia; the ones about transport, energy, water and digital networks are catalogued as records of their own, the others (population, health, culture, budgets and similar) are outside the scope of this catalogue. Coverage: Valencia. 269 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 12 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valencia-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
name: Valencia open data portal
notes: Catalogue-level record for a portal whose infrastructure datasets were added on 2026-09-29 (audit file names the outcome of every dataset read).

sources.note: Ajuntament de València open-data dataset index checked directly on 2026-10-08: title 'Conjunto de datos'; it states that these datasets are published by the Ayuntamiento de València and lists 279 datasets. The former Opendatasoft domain returned HTTP 404.
